hypothesis: Can Qwen3-8B extract one to three exact English spans for a supported atomic claim and refuse unsupported claims, while English DeBERTa independently separates entailment from non-entailment without losing useful evidence?
lanes: Qwen span lane: claim plus three source messages -> exact spans or NO_EVIDENCE
code lane: every returned span must be an exact substring of its named message
oracle NLI lane: locked exact spans -> English DeBERTa -> entailment, neutral or contradiction
end-to-end lane: accept only exact Qwen spans classified as entailment
claim_boundary: Fresh synthetic locked development test. Passing would justify a new blind English replication, not production approval.
